decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1).The proposed development, due to its size, scale and appearance would represent an incongruous structure, over developing the site and resulting in an unattractive addition to the area, harmful to the appearance of the street scene and  surrounding area. It would therefore constitute inappropriate infill development and be contrary to policy H.6.3 (Back land Development/Infill Development) and ENV.B.1.1 (All New Development) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.
2) The proposed dwelling by reason of its siting, size and scale would have an adverse affect upon the light and privacy of Nos.41 and 39 Clitherow Road and those flats contained within Manor House. This is contrary to Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines) and H.6.3 (Infill / Backland Development) of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development.
3) The proposed dwelling by reason of its size and siting would not provide sufficient amenity space for a residential property of this size. This is contrary to Policy H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines) of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 and the Unitary Development Plan Supplementary Planning Guidance 1997.
description: Erection of a two-bedroom detached house to existing site
